title: Unnamed insider on a UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, with an NRO badge and Q clearance
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range, Tonopah Test Range, Nevada

tellings.quote: Uh, one of whom specifically has claimed to have operated on a crash retrieval team, UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range.

plain: An unnamed insider is said to have worked on a team that recovers crashed UFOs, based out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, a huge military range that includes the Tonopah Test Range. The story comes from UAPGerb, an online researcher who goes by that name, who relays the person's claim and says they carried a badge from the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, and a Q clearance, the top clearance for US nuclear secrets. If true, it would mean crash recovery is a real, staffed operation in the Nevada desert.
